summary.en: VPN client; the 3.8.0 winget manifest lists a separate pia-windows-arm64 installer.
summary.zh-TW: VPN 用戶端，3.8.0 的 winget 資訊清單列有獨立的 pia-windows-arm64 安裝程式。

caveats.en: Source covers Windows on Arm in general; RTX Spark was not tested.
caveats.zh-TW: 來源涵蓋一般 Windows on Arm，未針對 RTX Spark 測試。

caveats.en: Only the installer architecture in the winget manifest was confirmed; runtime behavior is untested.
caveats.zh-TW: 只確認了 winget 資訊清單中的安裝檔架構，執行行為尚未驗證。

caveats.en: VPNs install network drivers; check the vendor's current support notes before relying on it.
caveats.zh-TW: VPN 會安裝網路驅動程式，使用前請先確認原廠最新的支援說明。
